title: Seahawks fans outnumber Patriots fans at Super Bowl LX

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Seahawks fans outnumber Patriots fans at Super Bowl LX
sources.description: PFT is on the scene at Super Bowl LX in Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, California, and a quick glance at the crowd makes one thing clear: There are a lot more Seahawks fans than Patriots fans here.
